prompts.prompt: Edit the supplied existing character sprite sheet, preserving EXACT character identity, costume, colors, proportions and fine pixel-illustration shading, soft RGBA edges. Produce ONE NEW transparent 8 columns x 4 rows sprite atlas, wide 2:1. No text, labels, grid, cast shadows, floor, motion lines, sparks or background. Full character in every cell with ample transparent margin, IDENTICAL scale, root center and planted ground baseline, NO unintended translation, NO changing size. Each row 8 real intermediate poses, NOT different characters. Row1 BLINK: standing neutral, slightly lowering eyelids, half closed, nearly closed, closed, half reopen, nearly open, exactly matching neutral. Only eyelids/secondary tiny ear motion, torso and BOTH feet identical registration, no bobbing. Row2 LOOK AROUND: neutral front, eyes turn left, small head turn left, left glance hold, center, small head turn right, right glance, exactly neutral front. Feet stay planted, do not slide torso. Row3 STRETCH: neutral front, arms/wings begin lifting, rising gently, full gentle stretch, hold, begin lowering, almost neutral, exactly neutral. Character appropriate arms/wings/ears/leaf/antenna detail, no jump, feet planted. Row4 WALK RIGHT: genuine side/three-quarter facing RIGHT walking-in-place cycle, 8 sequential locomotion poses alternating left and right legs, contact, down, passing, up, opposite contact, down, passing, up. Visibly step with feet and counter-swing arms or wings; natural character specific waddling for penguin/tree spirit, mechanical steps for robot, small padded steps for fox/dragon/owl/light creature. Keep center of body aligned in all walk cells, common ground contact baseline, consistent right-facing orientation, include both legs, no glide, no hopping; frame8 joins frame1 seamlessly. Walk has different limb poses, not a sliding still image. Native art detail, no artificial low-resolution filter/color quantization. Scale similar all four rows. Every row's first/last neutral except walking loop.
